id: 11_Laboratory Safety Training Handling Hazardous Materials with Confidence
title: 危险物料：心中有数再动手
source_doc: course/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/11_Laboratory Safety Training Handling Hazardous Materials with Confidence.md
author_source: project/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/11_Laboratory Safety Training Handling Hazardous Materials with Confidence/src.py

points.K1: 危险物料，实验室里躲不开
points.K2: 单位的责任：消除已知危害
points.K3: 三类重点：易爆、化学、病原
points.K4: 安全技术说明书随货提供
points.K7: 危险化学品先做危害分析
points.S3: 病原微生物：按级别、经批准

shots.scene: 欣欣站在试剂柜前，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a closed chemical cabinet with hazard pictograms and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲：危险物料，心中有数再动手。
overlay: 危险物料：心中有数再动手

shots.scene: 阿杰从柜里拿出一瓶新试剂，准备直接倒
shots.prompt_en: The young male student takes a new blank-labeled bottle from a cabinet and is about to pour it straight away.
shots.narration: 阿杰拿到一瓶没用过的试剂，就想直接用。

shots.scene: 小研递给他一份空白说明书，指了指
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hands him a blank safety data sheet and taps on it.
shots.narration: 小研说：先弄清它有什么危险。

shots.section_title: 危险物料，实验室里躲不开
shots.scene: 试剂柜、气瓶、生物安全柜图标并排
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a chemical cabinet, a gas cylinder and a biological safety cabinet side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里，难免会碰到危险物料。
overlay: 危险物料，实验室里躲不开

shots.section_title: 单位的责任：消除已知危害
shots.scene: 学校、学院、实验室三层图标，顶上一面盾牌
shots.prompt_en: Three stacked building icons of decreasing size under a large shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 学校和实验室有责任消除已知危害。
overlay: 单位的责任：消除已知危害

shots.section_title: 单位的责任：消除已知危害
shots.scene: 整洁的实验室，通道畅通、台面干净
shots.prompt_en: A tidy lab with clear aisles, clean benches and closed cabinets. No people.
shots.narration: 让实验室远离危害，保持整洁有序。

shots.section_title: 三类重点：易爆、化学、病原
shots.scene: 爆炸、化学瓶、病原微生物三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: an exploding bomb pictogram, a chemical bottle and a biohazard symbol with a microbe. No people.
shots.narration: 重点三类：易爆物、化学品、病原微生物。
overlay: 三类重点：易爆、化学、病原

shots.section_title: 安全技术说明书随货提供
shots.scene: 试剂箱打开，里面附着一份空白说明书
shots.prompt_en: An opened chemical delivery box with a bottle and a blank safety data sheet inside. No people.
shots.narration: 化学品到货，要附安全技术说明书。
overlay: 安全技术说明书随货提供

shots.section_title: 安全技术说明书随货提供
shots.scene: 王老师把说明书放进实验室文件夹
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator files a blank safety data sheet into a lab binder on a shelf.
shots.narration: 实验室收好，人人都能查到。

shots.scene: 说明书图标展开，浮现名称、厂家、成分图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank document icon unfolding with small icons: a name tag, a factory and a molecule. No people.
shots.narration: 里面有名称、生产商和危险成分。

shots.scene: 火焰、爆炸、反应箭头、人体健康图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a flame, an explosion, a reaction arrow and a human body with a warning mark. No people.
shots.narration: 理化特性，火灾爆炸、反应性和健康危害。

shots.scene: 手套、通风柜、盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a glove, a fume hood and a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 还有安全操作注意事项和控制措施。

shots.scene: 阿杰认真读说明书，头顶亮起灯泡
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reads a blank safety data sheet carefully with a light bulb glowing above his head.
shots.narration: 说明书是用好危险物料的第一依据。

shots.scene: 说明书上的爆炸图标亮起，旁边出现一本新规程
shots.prompt_en: An exploding bomb pictogram lights up on a blank sheet, and a second blank rule book appears beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 一看有爆炸危险，就要按更严的规程来。

shots.section_title: 危险化学品先做危害分析
shots.scene: 两个试剂瓶图标碰在一起，中间有警示闪光
shots.prompt_en: Two blank bottle icons touching with a warning flash between them. No people.
shots.narration: 危险化学品，特别是会剧烈反应的，
overlay: 危险化学品先做危害分析

shots.section_title: 危险化学品先做危害分析
shots.scene: 老周在白板前写下空白分析表
shots.prompt_en: The older man draws a blank analysis table on a whiteboard.
shots.narration: 用之前先做危害分析。

shots.scene: 老周、王老师、小研围坐讨论
shots.prompt_en: The older man, the safety administrator and the female graduate student sit around a table discussing.
shots.narration: 请懂行的人一起分析。

shots.scene: 火焰图标连向原因和后果两个问号
shots.prompt_en: A flame icon connected by arrows to two question marks labeled with blank cards. No people.
shots.narration: 可能怎么着火爆炸？后果有多严重？

shots.scene: 分子、天平、楼房三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a molecule, a balance scale with a ruler, and a building. No people.
shots.narration: 看物质性质、用量和距离、房间条件。

shots.scene: 人形图标和一叠旧事故报告图标
shots.prompt_en: A person icon with a gear, next to a stack of blank old incident reports. No people.
shots.narration: 还要看人的因素，查以往事故教训。

shots.scene: 大瓶试剂打叉，小瓶试剂打勾
shots.prompt_en: A huge bottle icon crossed out next to a small bottle icon with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 危险物料用多少领多少，不多存。

shots.scene: 小研在空白领用登记本上签字
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student signs a blank chemical withdrawal logbook at a storeroom window.
shots.narration: 领用登记，用剩的按规定退回或处置。

shots.scene: 两瓶试剂之间放着空白相容性表
shots.prompt_en: Two blank bottles with a blank compatibility chart between them. No people.
shots.narration: 两种物料混合前，先查是否相容。

shots.scene: 两个不相容的瓶子被隔开，废液桶上贴空白标签
shots.prompt_en: Two incompatible bottles separated by a divider, and a waste container with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 倒废液也一样，不相容的不能倒一起。

shots.section_title: 病原微生物：按级别、经批准
shots.scene: 生物危害标志和空白目录本
shots.prompt_en: A biohazard sign beside a blank catalog book and a lab door with a level icon. No people.
shots.narration: 病原微生物，按国家目录定实验室级别。
overlay: 病原微生物：按级别、经批准

shots.section_title: 病原微生物：按级别、经批准
shots.scene: 王老师在空白审批表上盖章
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator stamps a blank approval form at a desk.
shots.narration: 经过风险评估和批准，才能开始。

shots.scene: 夜里只有阿杰一人的实验室，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A lab at night with only the young male student working alone, crossed out with a red X.
shots.narration: 高危实验，不一个人做。

shots.scene: 小研和阿杰一起做实验，互相照应
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student work together at a fume hood, watching out for each other.
shots.narration: 有人在场，出事有人照应、有人报警。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现说明书、分析表、小瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a safety data sheet, an analysis table and a small bottle.
shots.narration: 先看说明书，再做危害分析。

shots.scene: 相容性表、审批章、两人小组图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a compatibility chart, an approval stamp and two people working together. No people.
shots.narration: 少量领用，查相容，经批准，不独做。

shots.scene: 欣欣抱着一份说明书挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a blank safety data sheet and waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 心中有数，动手才稳，下次见！
